name: Archimandrite
description: Leader of the Third Path who lived in the tallest Ivory Tower in Terisia City and named mana.

description_citations.text: "The Archimandrite". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Invited to Terisia City, Hurkyl joins others to establish the Union of the Third Path, seeking neutrality in the Brothers' War.
timeline.quote: Hurkyl joined her husband, Feldon , Chayum-Icha , Kathwar , and others to attend meetings to establish the Union of the Third Path .

citation.text: "Hurkyl", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hurkyl teaches meditation techniques to pupils including the Archimandrite.
timeline.quote: She taught her techniques to an increasingly growing crowd of pupils, including the Archimandrite .

citation.text: "Hurkyl", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hurkyl, Drafna, Feldon, Chayum-Icha, Kathwar and others meet with the Archimandrite to establish the Third Path as a neutral alliance.
timeline.quote: to establish the Third Path , also known as the "Union".

citation.text: "The Archimandrite", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Archimandrite shows aptitude at Hurkyl's meditative technique and names the energies "mana".
timeline.quote: The Archimandrite showed great aptitude at this
